---
title: "LLM cost control"
---

An LLM hook that fires on every edit burns tokens fast. This example spends a model call only when it earns its keep.

<!-- gd-embed: llm_cost_control.py -->

Four levers bound the cost. Cheap deterministic conditions like `SourceEdits`, `TestFile`, and `Content` run first, so the model only sees edits that already look suspicious. Then `skip_if=[Agent(...)]` skips planning subagents, `model="small"` picks the cheaper model, and `max_fires=1` stops after the first intervention. This hook carries no inline tests. An LLM verdict needs a recorded fixture or a live session under `uvx capt-hook test`, so verify it by replaying a session. See [Write an LLM hook](../guide/llm-hooks.qmd).
